description: Container image from a registry the scanner does not trust
note: CIS Kubernetes 5.5.1, and a measured quirk worth keeping: KSV-0125 treats only a *bare* image name as trusted. docker.io, registry.k8s.io and ghcr.io all fire it (measured 2026-09-20), so on a real repository this rule fires on essentially every image. Every other case here uses a bare name so that this rule is not noise in all of them.
